Certification

UKAS accredited certification bodies we work with

We build the system. These are two of the bodies that can assess it and issue the certificate.

Auva Certification Ltd

UKAS accredited certification body

Whether you are a local SME or global organisation, Auva aim to provide you with the certification expertise and knowledge tailored specifically to your business. Auva auditors are fully trained to have an in-depth knowledge of your industry, local compliance laws and regulations, and work with businesses of all sizes. All services are performed with the least possible disruption to your day-to-day operations.

  • A United Kingdom Accreditation Service (UKAS) accredited certification body
  • Head office in Essex
  • Free of charge transfer for companies already certified by an accredited body
  • ADL Consultancy is recognised as an Auva Approved Consultancy

QEC UK

UKAS accredited certification & training

QEC UK offers certification and training to ISO Standards. QEC UK is the UK agency of QEC Certification which forms part of SN Registrars (Holdings) Ltd, the UKAS Accredited certification body, part of a global certification network spanning over 40 countries and holding over 14,000 certificates worldwide.

  • Listed with UKAS under number 8327
  • Trading name: QEC Certification
  • Over 14,000 certificates issued worldwide
  • Certification and ISO training in one place

UKConsulting

We are also part of UKConsulting, a consultants' scheme that represents the interests of consultants and promotes high standards in the management consultancy industry. It is independent of certification bodies, and facilitates communication between management consultants, certification bodies, accreditation bodies and other interested parties.

Service partners

Partners we bring in for our clients

ADL Consultancy is proud to work in partnership with each of these businesses.

PilotIQ

IT, cyber & AI support

PilotIQ give small businesses tech support: making sure computers and internet-connected devices work seamlessly, stay protected from hackers, and that everyone using a computer or smartphone has a smooth experience.

  • Cyber Threat Monitoring
  • Desktop Managed Services
  • AI Implementation
  • Cyber Awareness Training for staff
  • IT Risk Assessments

People Smart HR

HR & employment law

People Smart HR specialise in helping small businesses navigate employment law and people problems, with tailored advice to suit each individual business. Friendly, non-judgemental and jargon-free, with solutions for all budgets.

  • Policies, handbooks and contracts
  • Disciplinaries and grievances
  • Engagement, benefits and TUPE
  • Resolution and improvement strategies

First Responders

First aid training

First Responders provide first aid training in Hemel Hempstead, Hertfordshire, North London and the home counties, from Oxfordshire to Essex, offering courses to industry, commerce and the community. We regularly use them to train our own consultants, and happily recommend them to our clients.

  • Founded in 1989 — one of the first independent training companies
  • Regulated RQF qualifications by Qualsafe Awards
  • Qualsafe Awards centre no. 904798
  • All courses Health & Safety compliant

Complete SHEQ Ltd

SHEQ consultancy & training

Complete SHEQ Ltd is a provider of Safety, Health, Environment and Quality consultancy, auditing and training. Located in the East Midlands with extensive UK coverage, they can provide anything from a basic Health and Safety Policy Statement to a complete, fully auditable SHEQ management system to ISO standards.

  • Safety, health, environment and quality consultancy
  • Auditing and training
  • East Midlands based, with UK-wide coverage
